name: Open Agent Leaderboard (Exgentic) results dataset
notes: INDEPENDENT leaderboard, not a vendor claim. Retrieval: https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows?dataset=open-agent-leaderboard/results kind is 'repo' because validate.py does not accept a 'leaderboard' kind. Figures here are measured by the leaderboard's own agent scaffold, so they are not comparable to a vendor card's numbers for the same model name and cannot be used to contradict them; they answer 'how does this model do when someone else drives it'.
